title: EDM v0.8.3 to v0.9.0 Migration Crosswalk (DRAFT, discovery)
description: Draft record of the v0.9 relayout proposed in docs/discovery/ontology-crosswalk-2026-10/v0.9-proposal.md. Five affective domains are renamed (core->narrative, constellation->emotion, milky_way->context, gravity->salience, impulse->motivation); 57 affective fields become 47 (39 carried by rename/move, 9 merged into others, 7 cut with text preserved in extensions, 2 moved to an opt-in trait profile, 7 new); every categorical field becomes text + codings; four fields become dimensions with a numeric value beside the ordinal text. No artifact text changes: scripts/v09_layout.py in the discovery folder proves the scalar multiset of the affective domains is identical before and after.
disposition_rule: One disposition per v0.8.3 field (carried / renamed / reshaped / merged / cut-to-extensions / moved-to-trait; new v0.9 fields are added) and one per canonical value (carried / carried (deprecated) / cut-to-extensions / moved-to-trait; new vocabulary values are added). carried = field name unchanged (domain rename or move only); renamed = field name changes; reshaped = enum or number becomes a dimension; merged = the v0.9 target has more than one v0.8.3 source. The uniform {text, codings} wrapping is recorded as shape_from / shape_to on each row. Value words never change. Audited by scripts/crosswalk_audit.py (crosswalk-audit-2026-10-18.md).

trait_profile.rule: Not part of any canonical profile. A partner profile opts in by listing trait.* in included_fields. Each value is recorded only as stated for this experience and is never aggregated into a person-level classification by the artifact.
trait_profile.migration: A v0.8.3 artifact carrying attachment_style or regulation_state keeps them in trait.* only when the target profile opts in; otherwise they are preserved verbatim in extensions.org.emotionaldatamodel.migration.out_of_profile_fields.

profiles.rule: Essential = 7 narrative + 4 emotion + salience.retrieval_cues (12; ruling 2026-10-17). A carried field is in Extended when any of its v0.8.3 sources was; the six new coded fields are Full-only. extensions is allowed in all three composites. text of coded fields is a recommended vocabulary (string; canonical list documented, not an enum); codings on the EDM vocabulary are enumerated. Draft schema: docs/discovery/ontology-crosswalk-2026-10/draft-schema/.

coded.text: string (the interpretation; mandatory when the field is populated)

dimension.value: number or null (never derived from text by migration)

backward_compatibility.v083_to_v090: Automatic. Paths change; no text changes. Cut fields are preserved verbatim under extensions.org.emotionaldatamodel.migration. New fields are null until re-extracted; the migration never infers them.
backward_compatibility.v090_to_v083: Lossy only for new fields and codings; the reverse map is field_map inverted.

steps: 1. Rename domains and fields per field_map.
2. Wrap categorical values as {text, codings} and apply codes from the vocabulary files; text is copied, never translated.
3. Carry numeric intensity into emotion.intensity.value; leave valence/urgency/control value null.
4. Concatenate echo + recall_triggers + retrieval_keys into salience.retrieval_cues; append higher_order_emotion to emotion.secondary; collect narrative_arc and arc_type into narrative.arc[].
5. Move attachment_style and regulation_state to trait.* only if the target profile opts in; otherwise preserve them in extensions.

7. Prune to the target profile manifest; any populated field outside it goes to extensions.org.emotionaldatamodel.migration.out_of_profile_fields (nothing for the seven synthetic examples once Essential carries salience.retrieval_cues).
